body:
Thanks!

BTW what’s the status and updated version representing precisely?
I’m asking because at least the status is empty most of the time. Maybe these should be after the extension make and artifact id. 
and if the url in the console could be made to cut vs overflow (not a console guru), that would solve the problem. 

Finally depending on the usefulness of the status and version thing, maybe simple should be the default vs full. For sure the property Quarkus. Is way too long to type. Could it be a env variable btw?

The status is previously their. So I don’t remove it. If the extension dependency have a fix version, it check if it is outdated.  but most of the time people use the bom, so it s useless.
For url, i can check the width of the console with the following lib and adapt the layout to the width, no?
https://github.com/jline/jline3

I don't understand the end of the message ? what do you talk the property quarkus ?

Right know I need to use something like -Dquarkus.foo.format=simple to use the simpler format, that's really long and hard to remember as a property.

Do you know what the status mean? Anyone else?
So these extra columns seem to be about the extensions you already have in your POM and for which you want to check whether an update is necessary? I could see that be a different command actually.
BTW on a parallel subject, I think this would add value https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/2500

So I propose to change column and order. Because the artefact Id must not be split on 2 line too. 
The default format may be the simple one, this:
Artefactid description
GuideUrl

For the other display format I propose to start from the use case. 

The full format will be rename by upgrade format: this format need too search on maven central the last available version of quarkus bom and quarkus extension and provide an upgrade oriented format. 

And I add the search format. But I must test to find the better column for this. Maybe the simple one is enough.
It’s based on your idea @emmanuelbernard but my proposal is more a way of thinking

I start the dev by set simple format by default and add carriage return before guide.
Do you want I rename the full format to upgrade and I change the way we extract version from bom and get it from somewhere else (what is the reference for delivery of quarkus extension? ), because I find this a little strange. And I am not sure it's our job to fin if plugin must be upgraded (there is already https://www.mojohaus.org/versions-maven-plugin/examples/display-plugin-updates.html)

I am not sure about the upgrade format. @aloubyansky how are people expected to discover the need for updates? Via `list-extensions` or differently? And if the use case is about the upgrade, then I guess a user does not care about extensions not present in its POM. My gut feeling says it should be in a separate command.
Yes, I would also have a separate command for checking for the available updates.
